title: K-flatness of an exhaustive split filtered union
statement: Let R be a commutative ring. Let C be a cochain complex, F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat R) ℤ, and ι m : F m ⟶ C and step m : F m ⟶ F (m+1). Assume every ι m is monic, step m ≫ ι (m+1) = ι m, every element of every C.X n lies in some image of ι m, and every F m is K-flat. Then C is K-flat: (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat C.

proof.text: The hypotheses identify C degreewise with the filtered colimit of the F m. Tensor comparison commutes with this filtered colimit; exactness of filtered colimits preserves the equalities of cycles and boundaries. Hence tensoring any acyclic complex with C is acyclic, which is K-flatness.

lean.statement:
theorem kFlat_of_exhaustive_split_colimit {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (ι : ∀ m : ℕ, F m ⟶ C)
    (step : ∀ m : ℕ, F m ⟶ F (m + 1))
    (hmono : ∀ m : ℕ, Mono (ι m))
    (hcompat : ∀ m : ℕ, step m ≫ ι (m + 1) = ι m)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ (n : ℤ) (x : C.X n),
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (y : (F m).X n), (ι m).f n y = x)
    (hstage : ∀ m : ℕ, (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R)
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat (F m)) :
    (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).kFlat C
